Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a global consulting firm specialising in Data & AI, dedicated to transforming data into measurable business impact. We combine business consulting with deep expertise in data, AI, analytics, and technology to help organisations accelerate their transformation.

Our multidisciplinary teams bring together consultants, data scientists, data engineers, AI engineers, and technology experts to deliver impactful solutions for leading organisations around the world.

As we continue to grow our Data & AI capabilities in Southeast Asia, we are looking for an AI Engineer to join our team in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

About the Role

As an AI Engineer, you will be a hands-on builder, working on the design, development, and deployment of AI and Generative AI solutions for our clients.

You will work within multidisciplinary teams and collaborate directly with client stakeholders to transform business challenges and ideas into practical, scalable AI solutions.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Build & Deploy AI Solutions: Design, prototype, test, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, from PoCs through to production.

  • Generative AI & LLMs: Develop solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, AI agents, and other emerging GenAI capabilities.

  • Machine Learning: Develop and integrate machine learning and deep learning models using relevant frameworks and libraries.

  • Cloud & AI Engineering: Build and deploy solutions using GCP, Azure, or AWS, including cloud-native AI services and data pipelines.

  • Solution Development: Contribute to the architecture and development of scalable, secure, and maintainable AI solutions.

  • Productionisation: Support deployment, monitoring, optimisation, and integration of AI solutions into client environments.

  • Client Collaboration: Work with business and technology stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

  • Continuous Innovation: Keep up with developments across AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, MLOps/LLMOps, and cloud technologies and apply them to real business use cases.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, AI/Machine Learning, or another relevant technical field.

  • Professional experience in AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical role.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with SQL.

  • Hands-on experience developing Machine Learning and/or Generative AI solutions.

  • Experience with LLM-related technologies such as RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, vector databases, or AI agents.

  • Familiarity with ML/AI frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent.

  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform: GCP, Azure, or AWS.

  • Good understanding of APIs, Git, software engineering practices, and the AI development lifecycle.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders.

What Would Give You an Advantage

  • Experience taking AI/GenAI solutions from PoC into production.

  • Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or other DevOps technologies.

  • Experience with frameworks and platforms for developing LLM or agentic AI applications.

  • Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery.

  • Previous experience working in a consulting or client-facing environment.

  • Experience working on enterprise-scale Data & AI projects.

Why Join Artefact?

Work at the forefront of AI. Build real-world solutions using Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, and emerging technologies.

Build, not just advise. Take ideas from experimentation and PoCs through to solutions that can be deployed and used by clients.

Work with multidisciplinary teams. Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Consultants, and AI specialists across Southeast Asia and Artefact's global network.

Develop your skills. Gain exposure to different industries, technologies, and business challenges while continuously developing your technical and consulting capabilities.

Make an impact. Help leading organisations turn AI opportunities into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.

Come and build the future of Data & AI with us.

About SleekFlow

SleekFlow is an AI Suite for Revenue-Driving Conversations. We are trusted by over 2,000 enterprises globally. But we are more than just a SaaS company; we are an AI-native movement redefining the B2C relationship across 70+ countries.


At our core is AgentFlow—an AI GTM workforce that learns, improves, and acts as a self-healing knowledge base for businesses. From first-click conversion to long-term retention, we turn every conversation into a data-backed growth opportunity. Headquartered in Singapore with a global presence in Hong Kong, the UAE, and the US, we are looking for exceptional people to help us build an AI operating system that matters.


Join us and rewrite how the world engages at scale.


Learn more from our blogs for developers: https://sleekflow.io/blog/category/developer-blog


Mid-Level

Location: Malaysia

Minimum Experience: 1~2 years of experience working with RAG/LLM development and deployment

Language: Fluency in English is required


Role

We are seeking a highly skilled LLM/RAG/Multi-Agent Infrastructure Engineer to design, develop, and optimize infrastructure for integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) via APIs, building efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, and enabling multi-agent frameworks. You will work at the intersection of AI applications, knowledge retrieval, and automation to create high-performance, scalable solutions that power next-generation AI-driven applications.


Key Responsibilities

  • LLM Evaluation: Assess the strengths and limitations of various LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere) to determine the best fit for specific applications and use cases.
  • RAG Pipeline Engineering: Develop and scale RAG architectures, integrating vector databases, retrieval mechanisms, and embedding models for efficient knowledge retrieval.
  • Multi-Agent Coordination: Design robust infrastructure to support multi-agent interactions, enabling efficient message passing, distributed decision-making, and autonomous collaboration.
  • Knowledge Base Development: Design and implement structured knowledge bases that enhance LLM output quality by integrating domain-specific data, ontologies, and automated document indexing.
  • Databases & Storage: Use vector databases, NoSQL databases, and caching mechanisms (e.g., Redis, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch) to support efficient knowledge retrieval and AI workloads.
  • Observability & Monitoring: Establish logging, monitoring, and tracing systems for API performance, system health, and anomaly detection.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure best practices for data privacy, security, and compliance in AI deployments.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, ML engineers, and software developers to integrate AI models into production environments effectively.


Required Qualifications

  • Experience with LLM APIs & RAG: Hands-on experience in integrating LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere) and building RAG pipelines with vector search (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone).
  • Multi-Agent Frameworks: Familiarity with multi-agent systems (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI) and their infrastructure requirements.
  • Knowledge Base Engineering: Experience in designing, indexing, and maintaining structured and unstructured knowledge bases, including knowledge graph construction, ontology design, and text embedding techniques.
  • CI/CD & MLOps: Experience with ML model versioning, deployment pipelines, and monitoring tools.
  • Prompt Engineering Expertise: Proficiency in designing clear, structured prompts, optimizing AI responses through iterative refinement, and leveraging advanced techniques like few-shot learning and chain-of-thought reasoning for improved accuracy and coherence.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in AI infrastructure for high-traffic SaaS or enterprise AI applications.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning and agent-based AI systems.
  • Experience with real-time streaming architectures (Kafka, Ray, or similar).
  • Experience in leveraging structured and semi-structured data for improving LLM-generated outputs.


Our Culture Code

  • Open-mindedness – We welcome different viewpoints and give and take feedback openly, always ready to challenge our own assumptions.
  • Collaboration – We have each other's back, share knowledge freely, and treat every teammate with equal respect.
  • Growth – We pursue continuous improvement, embrace new challenges, and treat mistakes as chances to learn.
  • Ownership – We take initiative, see things through, and hold ourselves accountable for the outcome.
  • Grit & Adaptability – We stay resilient through setbacks and adapt to change with patience and persistence.


What We Offer:

  • Attractive compensation package, including a 13th-month salary.
  • Stock options in a rapidly growing startup.
  • A fun, diverse, and international team culture.
  • Comprehensive group medical insurance.
  • Transport allowance.
  • Examination & education allowance.
  • Paid birthday leave.
  • Flexible work-from-home policy.
  • “Work From Anywhere” scheme.
  • Rewarding continuous learning from experienced team leads.
  • Many more exciting perks and growth opportunities!


Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.


SleekFlow is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

B. Automasi Proses Kerja (AI Automation)

  1. Mengenal pasti proses kerja manual yang boleh diautomasikan menggunakan AI.

  2. Membangunkan sistem automasi bagi mengurangkan kerja berulang dan kebergantungan kepada proses manual.

  4. Membangunkan sistem pemprosesan dokumen secara automatik seperti quotation, invoice, laporan dan dokumen projek.

  5. Meningkatkan kecekapan proses kerja melalui integrasi AI dengan aplikasi dan platform digital.

C. AI untuk Operasi Pembinaan dan Pengurusan Projek

  1. Meneroka penggunaan AI dalam proses pembinaan rumah dan pengurusan projek ZASMA.

  2. Membangunkan penyelesaian AI untuk membantu semakan dokumen teknikal, lukisan, spesifikasi dan laporan projek.

  1. Membantu menganalisis data projek bagi mengenal pasti risiko kelewatan, pembaziran kos dan isu kualiti.

  2. Membangunkan dashboard dan sistem pelaporan pintar untuk pihak pengurusan.

  3. Menggunakan data bagi mengenal pasti trend, corak prestasi dan peluang penambahbaikan.

  4. Menghasilkan analisis ramalan (predictive analytics) bagi membantu proses membuat keputusan.

  5. Memastikan data yang digunakan adalah tepat, relevan dan berkualiti.

E. Integrasi Sistem dan Penyelenggaraan

  1. Mengintegrasikan aplikasi AI dengan sistem dan perisian pihak ketiga melalui API.

  2. Memastikan sistem AI berfungsi dengan baik, stabil dan boleh digunakan oleh pengguna.

  3. Menjalankan troubleshooting, debugging dan penambahbaikan sistem.

  4. Melaksanakan ujian sistem sebelum sesuatu penyelesaian AI digunakan secara rasmi.

  5. Menyediakan dokumentasi teknikal, panduan penggunaan dan rekod penyelenggaraan.

  1. Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi terkini dalam bidang AI, Machine Learning dan Generative AI.

  2. Menilai kesesuaian teknologi AI baharu untuk diaplikasikan dalam operasi syarikat.

  4. Mencadangkan inovasi digital yang boleh memberikan kelebihan daya saing kepada ZASMA.

  5. Membandingkan keberkesanan teknologi dan platform AI dari aspek kos, fungsi, keselamatan dan pulangan pelaburan.

  5. Memastikan setiap penyelesaian AI mempunyai kawalan manusia (human oversight) bagi keputusan yang kritikal.

Salary: RM 10,000 – RM 13,000 per month

About the role

AI Development Engineer (MCP & Agent Direction) is responsible for engineering generative AI capabilities into film and animation production workflows, with focus on MCP toolchain construction, agent workflow orchestration, stylized rendering generation pipelines, and model distillation & compression. The role requires complete practical experience in generative models from training, evaluation to local deployment, capable of completing model compression, inference optimization and effect evaluation loops under local compute conditions, ensuring generation results are controllable, reproducible and accountable.

Key responsibilities

  • MCP server planning, development and governance: encapsulate image generation, video generation, asset retrieval, ComfyUI workflow execution, rendering data export capabilities as standard MCP tool interfaces; implement parameter specifications, permission control, cost marking and audit logs; align with MCP stateless specifications, support capability discovery, self-contained requests and standardized error handling; design MCP service interfaces for DCC integration

  • Agent workflow orchestration and implementation: support multi-step task decomposition and execution in film and animation production scenarios, support long task asynchronous execution, breakpoint continuation, failure retry and manual confirmation; implement Orchestrator-Worker, Fan-out/Fan-in, tool calling, structured output, RAG retrieval enhancement capabilities; establish evaluation metrics for agent success rate, manual intervention rate, retry rate, generation consistency and single-shot cost

  • Stylized rendering generation pipeline construction: manage style model training, evaluation and version management (LoRA / Style Pack / IP-Adapter); apply structural constraints (ControlNet, depth maps, normal maps, edge maps, reference image conditions); maintain character ID consistency and inter-shot style consistency; output layered data for AI neural rendering including depth, normal, Alpha, optical flow, camera trajectory, skeleton metadata

  • Model distillation, compression and inference acceleration: design distillation schemes for image, video and multimodal generation models including teacher/student model training, step distillation, training data construction and effect evaluation; complete quantization and inference acceleration engineering covering FP8, INT4, NVFP4, GGUF, ONNX, TensorRT, vLLM solutions; establish automated evaluation system covering FID/CLIP Score, prompt adherence, temporal stability, artifact rate and single-shot generation cost

  • Local inference service deployment and resource management: containerized deployment, interface encapsulation, multi-tenant isolation, GPU memory quota management, task queue and priority scheduling; establish cost accounting mechanisms for single image, single shot, per-second video generation; monitor service health, queue congestion, failure modes and regeneration trigger conditions

  • Third-party AI model API integration and orchestration: evaluate, integrate and orchestrate multiple third-party AI model APIs (image generation, video generation, 3D model generation, PBR material generation); design API routing strategies, load balancing and degradation schemes ensuring stability and timeliness in multi-model parallel calls

  • DCC software AI client integration: embed AI generation capabilities as plugins in DCC tools (Blender/Maya) enabling artists to call AI capabilities directly in software viewport; design and implement DCC plugin AI function modules including in-viewport AI generation preview, parameter adjustment panels, asynchronous task status monitoring; ensure AI operations integrate seamlessly with artist workflows

  • AI generated content quality evaluation system construction: establish automated quality evaluation pipeline for AI generated content including 3D model topology quality scoring, inter-frame consistency detection for video, material seamlessness checking, image style consistency assessment; establish quality gate standards ensuring AI output meets production archival threshold

  • Agent tool registry and capability discovery mechanism: design and manage MCP tool registry supporting tool version management, capability discovery, dependency declaration and compatibility verification; implement MCP Server capability declaration and auto-discovery protocol enabling AI Agent to dynamically perceive available tools and autonomously orchestrate calling chains

  • Multimodal generation pipeline design: design cross-modal AI generation pipelines (image→video→3D→material) involving format conversion between different models, condition data transmission, style consistency maintenance; design pipeline-level error handling, retry mechanisms and manual review nodes ensuring end-to-end reliability

  • Generation result reproducibility, version management and regression testing: implement model version locking, random seed recording, parameter snapshots, workflow JSON archiving and rendering manifest generation; establish regression testing mechanisms for style packs, distilled models, MCP tools and agent workflows; support version rollback and issue closure when quality, latency or cost baselines regress

  • Technology tracking and production introduction assessment: track technology progress in generative video, stylized rendering, MCP/Agent frameworks, local inference optimization; organize PoC verification and selection evaluation from quality, stability, license compliance and production adaptation dimensions providing actionable introduction recommendations

About you

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Automation, Computer Graphics or related field

  • 3+ years Python engineering development experience with service-oriented and containerized deployment practice

  • 1+ year generative model engineering experience covering at least two directions among training, evaluation, quantization, distillation or inference optimization

  • Strong English technical literature reading ability and technical documentation writing ability

  • Familiar with mainstream generative model training and inference processes including Stable Diffusion, FLUX / FLUX.2 Klein, Qwen-Image, AnimateDiff, LTX-2, Minimax H3 or equivalent diffusion/flow matching models

  • Deep hands-on experience with ComfyUI and/or Diffusers capable of completing workflow automation execution, custom node integration, model/VAE/LoRA management, batch scheduling and VRAM optimization

  • Master model compression and inference acceleration methods, familiar with at least two of: knowledge distillation, step distillation, FP8/INT4/NVFP4 quantization, LoRA merging, TensorRT, vLLM, GGUF/ONNX export or inference acceleration frameworks

  • Familiar with style fine-tuning training process (LoRA / Style Pack) capable of independently completing data construction, overfitting discrimination, style consistency evaluation and online closure

  • Large language model application development experience, familiar with tool calling, structured output, RAG retrieval enhancement, Function Calling, MCP tool registration and agent evaluation

  • Engineering judgment capability able to reasonably divide boundaries between model capabilities and rule logic, accurately attribute generation, inference and pipeline failures

  • Third-party AI model API integration and orchestration experience with actual engineering experience integrating multiple external AI generation APIs (image/video/3D generation), capable of implementing API routing design, load balancing, degradation strategies and circuit breaker mechanisms

  • DCC software AI client integration experience with actual development experience embedding AI capabilities as plugins in Blender/Maya and other DCC tools, understanding DCC plugin development frameworks, viewport integration mechanisms and artist workflow adaptation

  • AI generated content quality evaluation system construction experience capable of designing automated quality evaluation pipelines covering 3D model quality inspection, video consistency detection, material quality assessment dimensions, establishing quantifiable quality gate standards

Role Overview

As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end deployment of on-premise AI solutions. This role is a unique blend of high-performance hardware engineering and software stack orchestration. You will be the driving force behind the physical assembly of high-performance computing hardware, operating system provisioning, and the deployment of containerized AI applications.

You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for ensuring system reliability and performance at client sites, bridging the gap between raw silicon and production-ready AI models.

Key Responsibilities

  • Systems Integration: Perform full-cycle hardware assembly, including the integration of high-performance Motherboards (MB), CPUs, GPUs, and high-speed NVMe/SSD storage arrays.

  • Logistics & Hardware Management: Oversee the end-to-end logistics lifecycle of hardware assets, including inventory tracking, shipping, and coordinated onsite installation to ensure seamless customer delivery.

  • Deployment & Maintenance: Provision and configure Linux-based environments and specialized AI software stacks on-premise, ensuring environments are tuned for heavy compute.

  • Container Management: Deploy and manage AI applications using Docker, ensuring containers are optimized, resource-constrained, and running according to specification.

  • System Diagnostics: Monitor system health and perform deep-dive debugging by analyzing Docker logs, kernel logs (dmesg), and hardware telemetry to preempt failures.

  • Collaborative Troubleshooting: Isolate and resolve complex network configurations, driver conflicts (NVIDIA/CUDA), and hardware-level failures.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Experience: 1–2 years in infrastructure support, system administration, or similar roles. Fresh graduates with strong Linux and "homelab" infrastructure knowledge are encouraged to apply.

  • Hardware Proficiency: Deep understanding of PC/Server architecture, including CPU architectures, GPU power requirements, PCIe lane distribution, and DRAM/Storage scaling.

  • OS & Scripting: Strong command of the Linux CLI (Ubuntu/CentOS) for filesystem management, networking configuration, and shell scripting for task automation.

  • Containerization: Practical experience managing Docker environments and understanding container lifecycles.

  • Precision & Detail: High level of precision in physical assembly, including cable management, thermal application, and firmware/BIOS updates.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Orchestration: Basic understanding of Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.

  • NVIDIA Stack: Familiarity with the NVIDIA AI Enterprise stack and GPU operator deployments.

  • Communication: Ability to translate complex technical issues into clear status reports for both internal engineering teams and non-technical client stakeholders.

jobs.api_description_text:
What you will do

Design the flow and architecture

  • Map the current lot disposition flow with quality, product and process engineers (hold triggers, evidence gathered, decision rules, MRB, approval levels) and design the target AI-assisted flow: what is automated, what is assisted, and what stays manual.
  • Own the end-to-end solution architecture: data ingestion, feature and context layer, ML models, LLM/agent reasoning, decision workflow and audit trail.
  • Produce the High-Level Design (HLD): system context, component, data-flow and deployment views, integration landscape, and non-functional requirements such as latency, availability, security and scalability.
  • Produce and sign off the Low-Level Design (LLD): service and API contracts, data models and schemas, agent and tool definitions, model and prompt interfaces, sequence diagrams and error handling.
  • Make and document the key trade-offs (build vs buy, cloud vs on-prem, model selection) and own the architecture decision records.

Build the models and agents

  • Build agents that assemble the evidence pack for a held lot by pulling lot genealogy, SPC charts, inline and parametric data, wafer maps, test-bin summaries and equipment history through tool-calling.
  • Combine traditional ML with LLM reasoning: hold-reason classification, anomaly and excursion detection, wafer-map pattern recognition, and similarity search over historical dispositions and 8D/MRB records.
  • Generate disposition recommendations with confidence scores, cited evidence and a plain-language rationale that an engineer can verify in seconds.

Set best practices for tooling and engineering

  • Define the team's engineering toolchain and standards: repository structure, coding standards, branching and code review, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and environment strategy.
  • Set MLOps/LLMOps practices: experiment tracking, model registry, prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, monitoring, drift detection, rollback and cost tracking.
  • Set documentation standards (HLD/LLD templates, ADRs, runbooks) so the system can be supported and extended beyond the original team.

Make it safe for automotive-grade quality

  • Design the human-in-the-loop controls: confidence thresholds, approval routing, override capture, and a staged path from recommend-only to auto-release for well-understood, low-risk hold types.
  • Build full traceability into every recommendation (input data, model and prompt version, rationale and final human decision) to meet IATF 16949 and customer audit expectations.
